customer: I'm trying to sell my midsize SUV to Northwind and just realized my ex-husband's name is still on the title. We've been divorced for over a year and I really don't want to have to track him down for a signature. Is there any way around this?
agent: I understand the frustration, and our article "My ex is still on the title" covers this exact situation. Normally an ex-spouse who's still listed on the title has to sign, the same as any co-owner. However, if your divorce decree awarded the SUV to you, just bring a certified copy of the decree and your ex's signature won't be needed. Also, if your name changed in the divorce, take a look at "The name on the title doesn't match my ID" as well.
